ReportRelation.ReportRelationExpression: Left join vwdb_Item on vwdb_PurchaseOrder.ItemID = vwdb_Item.ItemID
Left join vwdb_PaymentTerm on vwdb_PurchaseOrder.PaymentTermID = vwdb_PaymentTerm.PaymentTermID
Left join vwdb_Supplier on vwdb_PurchaseOrder.SupplierID = vwdb_Supplier.SupplierID
Left join vwdb_Users on vwdb_PurchaseOrder.RequesterID = vwdb_Users.UserID
Left join vwdb_PurchaseRequisition on vwdb_PurchaseOrder.PRTranID = vwdb_PurchaseRequisition.TranID And vwdb_PurchaseOrder.ItemID = vwdb_PurchaseRequisition.ItemID

ReportFields.ReportFieldName: Case When vwdb_PurchaseOrder.ItemDescription = '' Then vwdb_Item.ItemTitle Else vwdb_PurchaseOrder.ItemDescription End
( SELECT FlagValue FROM tblCompanyFlag AS tbl WHERE FlagName = 'IsHeaderAndFooterRequiredOnDCDocumentReports' AND tbl.CompanyID = vwdb_PurchaseOrder.CompanyID )

ParameterSetup.ParameterFilter: vwdb_SalesPerson.SalesPersonID in (select * from Fx_GetSalesPersonIDsbyUser('{UserID}')) And companyid=2

CompanyGlobalParameter.GlobalParameterValue: 12- C Block 6 near karachi food Shahr-e-faisal Karachi
